💬  This appears to be a list of flags that can be used with the Remote Desktop Protocol (RDP). The flags are organized into categories, such as "General", "Authentication and Security", and "Display". Each flag is identified by a number and has a corresponding name. Some examples include:
- General: FreeRDP\_ClientProductId - this flag specifies the product ID for the RDP client being used.
- Authentication and Security: FreeRDP\_EarlyCapabilityFlags - this flag indicates whether the client supports early capability negotiation in RDP sessions.
- Display: FreeRDP\_SupportGraphicsPipeline - this flag indicates whether the client supports graphics pipelines in RDP sessions.
